semantics.readonly_rule: Default is read-only; edits produce candidate contract changes.
semantics.identity_rule: Contract, Topic, projection node/edge and human prose identities/representations remain distinct.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing/editing candidate docs grants no runtime authority.
semantics.graph_rule: Rendered semantic edges correspond only to explicit refs.
semantics.action_rule: edit/validate/apply contract changes use separate authorized workflows.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.

hard_gates.condition: visual edit changes live semantics immediately
